title: Crop Math: DLI from PPFD and Photoperiod
summary: Calculate daily light integral from representative PPFD and the actual photoperiod while keeping intensity, distribution and environmental context visible.
limitations: The result is a photon-dose calculation, not a universal cultivation target.
Equal DLI can result from different PPFD/photoperiod combinations and does not prove equal biological response.
Use representative canopy PPFD rather than an isolated peak reading.
Interpret the result with spectrum, crop stage, temperature, water status, carbon dioxide and plant response.
